year.description: The year (1-9999) to display. Must be fully specified.

month.description: The month (1-12) to display. Ignored if yearly is true.

farsi.description: Enable Farsi numbers and names (-p flag).

pahlavi.description: Display year based on Pahlavi epoch (-P flag).

english.description: Display English names for weekdays (-e flag).

yearly.description: Display a calendar for the entire year (-y flag).

three_month.description: Display previous, current, and next month output (-3 flag).
